Display North Flight (Casual Clothes)
"Collecting things that make your heart flutter," maybe?

My secret, huh...
Hmm, if I had to put it into words—

It could be a souvenir you bought, something you stumbled upon on a trip...
Or maybe a memento filled with memories of someone special.

! When you think of summer, you think of this, right?
It helps ease training fatigue, so I highly recommend it♪

I've already looked over the training schedule.
The way things are going, a slight change of plans shouldn't be an issue, right?
Do you like it?

(Yes... whenever I'm with them, they keep multiplying.
Before I knew it, I was always on the receiving end...)
A brand-new 'flutter' for you, Trainer!

I'm sure that every time I see a beautiful sunset, I'll remember today.
When I told her that, North Flight smiled with deep satisfaction.

Sunglasses, perfume... The reason I suddenly got so hooked on them
is because you gave me a story to go with them.

Welcome~!
Would you like some ice cream~?
Sometimes, it's wonderful to be inspired by someone else, too... don't you think?♪

I'm so glad. It looks like I was able to give plenty back to you today.
This wonderful feeling that I discovered...!

...!
Fufu. I'm sure they'll just keep growing on their own.

It's a beach resort I checked out before the camp started♪
They say there's lots to enjoy—delicious food, scenic walks, shopping, and more!
S-o... why don't we take a breather just for tomorrow?

When I realized that, I thought to myself:
it would be such a waste to keep this sparkle all to myself.

Yes. Things that make your heart flutter, things you love...
The moment those things multiply, it creates an incredible 'sparkle.'

Is there anything you'd like to do or something you enjoy during this camp?
Anything at all is fine, please let me keep you company!
As long as the two of us are together, our world... can keep expanding without end!
That's why I wanted to share it with you too, Trainer.

Just as expected~! Senpai... how do you always manage to stay
so fashionable? Come on, tell me, is there a secret to it?

Fufufu! ...I knew it, you haven't noticed, have you?
You're the one who gave that to me—

Hmmmm...
In that case, let's go find some together.

Since we came all the way to the beach,
I thought it might be nice for you to unwind for once.

Is it about time?
Oh, look over there—
Looks like you found another thing that makes your heart flutter♪

I finally understood what she meant.
I was bewildered by the unexpected thank-you, but... it made me happy.

Midsummer is in full swing, and training camp has begun once again!
As always, North Flight is taking thorough precautions against the heat.
Trainer, are you still working?

Yes, yes, that's a wonderful mindset!
And another thing...

Fufufu.
Oh, I just had a great idea♪
How lovely~! Maybe I should buy one too...!

When it comes to fashion, having a story behind things is important, too.
Don't you have items that you just find yourself strangely attached to?

Oh, we've already found a wonderful shop!
Everything looks so delicious...! Would you like to stop for a bite?
Wonderful...! Let's keep enjoying ourselves just like this♪

I try doing a voice search on my smartphone.
Seeing that, North Flight breaks into another delighted smile.

Things you 'love,' moments that make you 'happy' or 'excited.'
When those feelings multiply, your whole world broadens.

I'm glad! A magazine mentioned that this is a famous sunset spot.
I figured something like this would 'strike a chord' regardless of personal tastes.

Can you tell? It's a new eau de toilette♪
Doesn't it have a refreshing scent that's just perfect for the humid summer?
I see~! So you mean keeping your antennae raised, right!?

Nothing came to mind right away when she asked.
As I hesitated, wondering what brought this on all of a sudden...

Fufu, thank you for your hard work.
You really are dedicated as always, aren't you?
Waaah~! Those sunglasses look so cool!

The Umamusume swarm around her in excitement. As expected of a fashion leader.
At this rate, a sunglasses craze is sure to sweep through the training camp.

Night—having some spare time, I was getting ahead on upcoming work
when I heard footsteps approaching.

Senpai, your taste really is impeccable~!
You smell subtly amazing today too, and...

—After that, North Flight led me to a quiet spot.
She turned to me with a sincere expression and began to speak.
Wah~ so lively♪ I can't believe they're even holding a music festival!

—And so, I wrapped up the following afternoon's training early.
I didn't want to let her thoughtful consideration go to waste.

Where she pointed, the evening sun touched the horizon over the distant ocean.
A dazzling glow bathed the water and sky in shimmering color.

The words slipped effortlessly from my lips.
The reason this feels so beautiful is because I'm here with her.

My world is expanding. In racing, in fashion...
All thanks to you!

After we went shopping, I realized something!
'Whenever I'm with you, the things I love just keep growing...!'

That's why I invited you out today. Fufufufu... Oh?
It got completely dark while we were lost in conversation, didn't it?

Mmm~♪ It really feels like summer.
What do you think, Trainer?
